description: Explains a bedroom CO₂ reading against the precautionary 800 ppm average-while-asleep goal: band, distance from the goal, whether the measurement is comparable, signs of a monitor reading low, and free fixes with trade-offs. The goal is not a health limit. Door-open nights appear only as one-night tests, not fixes.

measured.description: night_average: the average while asleep (a monitor’s recorded night). overnight_high: the highest number overnight (what most monitors show and people remember). spot: one reading at one moment. If unsure, use overnight_high for a morning number and spot for a daytime one.

ppm.description: The reading in parts per million

sleepers.description: People who slept in the room that night, if known

name: explain_co2_reading
title: Explain a CO₂ reading
